dict.string: Flicker requires screen recording permission to take screenshots and record screen videos.
Flicker requires microphone access to record audio during screen video recordings.
Flicker requires system audio access to record your Mac's output audio (e.g., YouTube, games) during screen recordings. This is used only when you enable “System Audio” in video settings.
Flicker does not use the camera, but this description is included to support future features that may require it.
